Advocate for the Petitioner : Mr. S.N. Morampalle
 Coram : S. G. Chapalgaonkar, J.
 Dated : June 14, 2024

This proceedings is moved invoking the provisions of Contempt of Courts Act, alleging
non-compliance of the order passed by this Court in First Appeal No.911 of 2004 granting
compensation in favour of the petitioner under the Provisions of the Motor Vehicles Act.
2.  Apparently, this Court decided the First Appeal No.911 of 2004 and granted enhanced compensation in favour of the original claimants.
It is alleged that inspite of the award passed by this Court; only principal amount has been paid and interest part is still be to recovered.
3. Considering the submissions advanced, apparently, this is a case where the Award passed by the Tribunal and modified by this Court is subject matter.
Petitioner is having remedy to file Execution proceedings/Darkhast before the Tribunal/Executive Court.
In such circumstances, Contempt Petition cannot be entertained.

( S. G. CHAPALGAONKAR, J. ) ...
